verdict.rationale: Snowflake docs show orchestration capability via dbt Projects on Snowflake ('develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe your transformations') and a headless Snowflake CLI ('snow sql') that can run SQL scripts non-interactively, which an AI-native user could wire into external schedulers or cron jobs. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of Snowflake's native recurring-job/scheduler primitive (e.g., a TASK object with cron syntax) or any first-party scheduling API tied to Cortex/agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native scheduled-task object, cron-style recurrence syntax, or an agent-facing API for creating/managing recurring jobs, and any hands-on confirmation that AI-native users actually use this for automation.
